kind: Authorized pure-memory focused C PLT32 controls; normal inherited-XDG cores grant; no producer/image/remote work

args.cmd:
env -u CCC_OVERRIDE_OPTIONS -u COMPILER_PATH -u GCC_EXEC_PREFIX -u LD_PRELOAD cores -n 1 -- sh -c 'set -eu
set -x
trap '\''task_exit=$?; sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS; printf "focused_inner_exit=%s\n" "$task_exit"; exit "$task_exit"'\'' EXIT
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
sha256sum source/hp_elf.c source/hp_elf.h source/elf_controls.c source/plt32_controls.c /usr/bin/clang-23 /home/david/dev/scripts/cores
/usr/bin/clang --no-default-config -std=c17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fwrapv -funsigned-char -fno-strict-aliasing source/hp_elf.c source/plt32_controls.c -o plt32-strict
printf "strict_compile_exit=0\n"
./plt32-strict
printf "strict_run_exit=0\n"
/usr/bin/clang --no-default-config -std=c17 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -fwrapv -funsigned-char -fno-strict-aliasing -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all source/hp_elf.c source/plt32_controls.c -o plt32-sanitized
printf "sanitized_compile_exit=0\n"
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1 ./plt32-sanitized
printf "sanitized_run_exit=0\n"
sha256sum plt32-strict plt32-sanitized' > focused-full.log 2>&1
task_run_status=$?
printf 'outer_exit=%s\n' "$task_run_status" > outer-status.txt
exit "$task_run_status"
